Subject: Cross-border payment mapping: CloudWave remittance ambiguous

Team —

Quick escalation on a CloudWave payment that hit our suspense and is causing VAT allocation noise in AR aging. Bank posted two incoming credits on 2026-05-08 but remittance doesn't map cleanly to our invoices. Key facts:

- Bank credits: EUR 124,500 (SEPA received 2026-05-08 02:13 UTC) and USD 12,000 (ACH received 2026-05-08 18:47 UTC).
- Remittance (attached remittance_20260508.pdf) lists invoice numbers INV-2026-1492, INV-2026-1493 and a line: "VAT withholding / credit 20,000 EUR". Amounts on remittance don't equal cleared EUR amount after bank fee and FX.
- Our AR shows full outstanding invoices: INV-2026-1492 = EUR 90,000, INV-2026-1493 = EUR 40,000 (total EUR 130,000).
- Payment applied by bank to suspense GL 2100. VAT team flagged: the "VAT withholding" line suggests customer credited VAT separately — if that is the case we need to book VAT receivable/payable adjustments rather than write-off.

Can someone triage mapping and propose the journal correction? Options I think feasible: partially apply EUR to INV-1492 and INV-1493, allocate bank fees to GL 6540, book VAT hold to 2205 (VAT payable) pending receipt of documentary evidence, and book FX gain/loss to 6690.

Attaching bank statement and remittance. I will loop in CloudWave AP if we need confirmation (I tried ap@cloudwave.com but no reply yet).

Thanks — please reply with recommended JV (amounts + FX) so Marcus can post.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik —

Apologies for the delay. Confirming we sent two transfers on 2026-05-08: SEPA for EUR 124,500 and an ACH for USD 12,000. The EUR payment covers invoices INV-2026-1492 and INV-2026-1493 but we applied an internal VAT credit of EUR 5,500 (our mistake in how we exported the remittance). That "VAT withholding / credit 20,000 EUR" line on the export is actually a bulk field and includes prior adjustment lines; the correct VAT credit for these invoices is EUR 5,500.

We attached our remittance and a payment advice (we've also cc'd our AP mailbox). Bank fees were charged on our side for the USD leg — we didn't deduct fees from the EUR payment.

Files attached from our side: CloudWave_remit_08052026.pdf (lists invoice references) and CW_payment_advice_08052026.pdf. If you need a signed VAT credit note I can request it from our tax team but that will take 2–3 business days.

Karthik / Grace / Marcus —

Thanks for the context and Elena for the clarification. Based on what we have, here is a proposed mapping and draft JV to clear suspense and update AR/VAT:

Summary of numbers (using bank EUR posting amounts):
- Bank EUR credit: 124,500 EUR
- Customer confirmed VAT credit to apply: 5,500 EUR (per Elena)
- Outstanding invoices: INV-2026-1492 (90,000 EUR) + INV-2026-1493 (40,000 EUR) = 130,000 EUR
- Shortfall before fees/FX: 5,500 EUR short vs invoices (130,000 required), but customer says 5,500 is a VAT credit to be booked separately — so application makes sense.

Proposed actions (draft journal):
1) Apply payments to invoices:
   - Apply EUR 90,000 to INV-2026-1492 (clear)
   - Apply EUR 34,000 to INV-2026-1493 (partial apply)
   - Create AR balance on INV-2026-1493 = EUR 6,000 outstanding
2) Move VAT credit to VAT control account (2205) rather than AR write-off:
   Dr 2100 Suspense 5,500 EUR
   Cr 2205 VAT Payable 5,500 EUR
3) Bank fee (if any on our side) to GL 6540 — currently unknown; Marcus to confirm fee amount and currency conversion.
4) FX difference (EUR posted vs EUR application) to GL 6690 FX gain/loss — calculate on posting.

Draft journal (post once FX and bank fee confirmed):
- Dr AR INV-1492                        90,000.00 EUR
- Dr AR INV-1493                        34,000.00 EUR
- Dr Bank (EUR) (clear suspense entry) 124,500.00 EUR
- Cr Suspense GL 2100                  124,500.00 EUR
... then internal reallocations per steps 1–4 above.

Questions for Marcus / Treasury: confirm bank fee on the ACH leg (USD) and the EUR posting bank charges (if any). Also need to confirm the exact Euro-to-USD exchange rate used by bank for reporting FX if we book a USD leg conversion.

If everyone OK I will prepare the CSV for Marcus to post.

Laura Bennett
Senior AR Analyst
Redwood Inference
